name: AI Playgrounds
description: Fifteen multilingual interactive AI playgrounds with standalone offline HTML downloads. v1.9.6 preserves complete classroom drafts and chosen evidence, improves keyboard recovery and Activity Pack printing, guards Minimax predictions, clarifies learning results, and corrects reinforcement-learning state and Bayesian preset inference. Human learner, educator, and screen-reader validation is deferred; no WCAG conformance or validated learning-outcome claim is made.
